title: Longitudinal data revealed distinct epilepsy outcome trajectories
summary: In 2,586 retrospectively followed epilepsy patients, the study identified five longitudinal trajectory clusters, including three associated with better and two with poorer outcomes. One poorer-outcome cluster had persistent high seizure burden and hippocampal sclerosis. Single-center retrospective data and internal evaluation do not establish prospective clinical benefit or external generalization.
